google_play.title: Kinaara: Serious Dating
google_play.short_description: Fewer, better introductions in Delhi NCR, matched both ways. For adults 18+.
google_play.full_description:
Kinaara is a dating app for adults in Delhi NCR who want something real, and are tired of endless swiping.

Every day you get a short set of introductions: people whose intention and preferences fit yours, both ways. Open a profile, then like or pass. Everyone gets the same few likes a day, and likes are never sold. When you both say yes, it's a match, and only matches can message each other.

What's different:
- Your intention is required (marriage, a long-term relationship, or something serious you're still figuring out), and it's matched both ways.
- A short daily set instead of an endless stack.
- Live: short video calls with someone new whose preferences match yours. Their video stays hidden until you choose to see it, and you can end, move on or report at any moment.
- Honest labels: we show only what we actually checked (email verified, age declared). Identity is not checked, and the app says so.
- Your area, never your exact location: others see an area and a distance range.
- Every safety tool is free: block, report, unmatch, pause, and photo review before anyone else sees a new photo.
- A guided tour of the app, in words or read aloud.

Kinaara Plus (optional): more Live calls after your free ones, longer calls, and no ads. One published price for everyone. It never changes who sees you or how many likes you get.

Free members may see ads in the app. Ads are never shown in chats, Live calls, profiles or Safety.

Kinaara is in beta. Things will change, and your feedback shapes them. For adults 18 and over.
